Previews (dryRun:true) do not queue Workbench approval. When approval is enabled, a real write first runs this tool's own preview in the same session. Invalid writes return without approval: meta.outcome=rejected-before-operation, meta.execution=not-started, and meta.warnings contains code=APPROVAL_PRECHECK_REFUSED with details.stage=approval-precheck. A successful preview is followed by exactly one Workbench decision; native preconditions run again after approval. Denial returns error.code=CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and error.details.reason=denied. Approval disabled skips this precheck and preserves APPROVAL_DISABLED warnings. Tools without a preview keep their existing approval gate. After OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, later native reads and writes return SESSION_RESET_REQUIRED, reason=previous-outcome-unknown, without approval; inspect TIA, then DisconnectPortal and establish a new explicit ConnectPortal/AttachOpenProject session.

Previews (dryRun:true) do not queue Workbench approval. When approval is enabled, a real write first runs this tool's own preview in the same session. Invalid writes return without approval: meta.outcome=rejected-before-operation, meta.execution=not-started, and meta.warnings contains code=APPROVAL_PRECHECK_REFUSED with details.stage=approval-precheck. A successful preview is followed by exactly one Workbench decision; native preconditions run again after approval. Denial returns error.code=CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and error.details.reason=denied. Approval disabled skips this precheck and preserves APPROVAL_DISABLED warnings. Tools without a preview keep their existing approval gate. After OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, later native reads and writes return SESSION_RESET_REQUIRED, reason=previous-outcome-unknown, without approval; inspect TIA, then DisconnectPortal and establish a new explicit ConnectPortal/AttachOpenProject session.

With overwrite:false, an existing logical object is refused before the native import: error.code=INVALID_ARGUMENT, error.details.parameter=overwrite, message "Object '<name>' already exists; overwrite=false refuses replacement.", meta.outcome=rejected-before-operation and meta.execution=not-started. With approval enabled the approval-precheck makes no Workbench request; no approval click is needed. To replace deliberately, preview this same file/target with overwrite:true, then use dryRun:false, confirm:true and the exact expectedProjectFile; wait for approval and inspect the result.

The XML file must exist on the TIA machine. Forward slashes (C:/Examples/exports/Tags.xml) and back slashes (C:\Examples\exports\Tags.xml) address the same file; Foundation passes the normalized full path to Openness. A missing file returns INVALID_ARGUMENT, error.details.parameter=importPath and message "An existing Openness XML file is required."

Overwrite backup is best effort: an inconsistent/protected target or refused export does not block import. Inspect BACKUP_SKIPPED warnings (object and reason) and data.recoveryStatus=backup-skipped; retain successful recovery exports.

BACKUP_SKIPPED has the same message, details.objects (object/reason) and details.recoveryDirectory on success or failure on both hosts. recoveryDirectory is null when no backup directory was created; NATIVE_WARNING remains separate for native diagnostics. Known blockers are checked before creating a recovery directory. Target group/software preconditions still refuse before approval.

GenerateBlocksFromExternalSource.note: Foundation external sources require ASCII text without a BOM. filePath and allowedFilePath accept C:/Examples/FC_Add.scl or C:\Examples\FC_Add.scl; separator normalization preserves all other canonical local-drive rules (no traversal, redundant separators, device names or UNC). Import, generation and deletion each require their own preview, then dryRun=false, confirm=true, expectedProjectFile and expectedPlanHash from that same operation. PlanPlcExternalSourceImport is planning only: its hash cannot execute ImportPlcExternalSource. Use the exact SourceName returned by import or ListPlcExternalSources. Generation can overwrite existing blocks/types; review the intended source and project before execution. Preview inspects source identity and existing block/type metadata, not the source contents. Generation is not full PLC compilation: subsequently call CompilePlcDiagnostics and inspect state, aggregate counts and nested diagnostics. V15.1+ uses GenerateBlockOption.None and maps native returned objects to actual PLC paths. V14 SP1 has only a void method: GeneratedObjects remains empty; ObjectsAfter/ObservedChanges are inventory observations, not a complete generated-object list. Status=failed, Attempted=true, Executed=false and RequiresSessionReset=false mean the native generator rejected the source and restored its generation changes. Read Error, correct the source and prepare a fresh preview before an explicit retry. This rollback guarantee applies to generation only, not source import. Status=outcome-unknown requires inspection; do not repeat generation automatically. Previews (dryRun:true) do not queue Workbench approval. When approval is enabled, a real write first runs this tool's own preview in the same session. Previews (dryRun:true) do not queue Workbench approval. When approval is enabled, a real write first runs this tool's own preview in the same session. Invalid writes return without approval: meta.outcome=rejected-before-operation, meta.execution=not-started, and meta.warnings contains code=APPROVAL_PRECHECK_REFUSED with details.stage=approval-precheck. A successful preview is followed by exactly one Workbench decision; native preconditions run again after approval. Denial returns error.code=CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and error.details.reason=denied. Approval disabled skips this precheck and preserves APPROVAL_DISABLED warnings. Tools without a preview keep their existing approval gate. After OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, later native reads and writes return SESSION_RESET_REQUIRED, reason=previous-outcome-unknown, without approval; inspect TIA, then DisconnectPortal and establish a new explicit ConnectPortal/AttachOpenProject session.

With approval enabled the approval-precheck makes no Workbench request; no approval click is needed. To replace deliberately, preview this same file/target with overwrite:true, then use dryRun:false, confirm:true and the exact expectedProjectFile; wait for approval and inspect the result.
